result.summary: The page is largely well-rendered, but the bottom navigation bar has a clear visual defect: a dark horizontal bar overlaps the middle two tab icons (search and orders), obscuring them. Everything else — header, search, filter chips, promo banner, and restaurant cards — appears intact.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, a thick dark horizontal line/bar is drawn across the search and orders tab icons, partially covering them. It looks like a misplaced active-tab indicator or a stray divider element overlapping the icons.
issues.suggestion: Inspect the bottom tab bar for an incorrectly positioned indicator or divider element; ensure the active-tab indicator is sized to a single tab and positioned above/below the icon rather than across it, and remove any stray border/decoration overlapping the icons.

issues.description: The bottom navigation icons have no text labels, and the (partially obscured) search and orders icons are hard to identify, reducing clarity of navigation.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels under each tab icon and ensure icons are not obstructed so their meaning is clear.
